packs.description: Reduce input reads for deduplication while preserving first-seen order; deterministic work proxy, not wall-clock speed.
Improve signed integer classification using fixed paired development tasks and an optional disjoint held-out split.
Tune a one-dimensional classification recipe against local synthetic labeled data. Non-Git selected-file material; no transfer claim.

environment.git: available on PATH for owned material
environment.inference: User-selected exact coordinator/executor/subject model identities through native Pi/Fabric; no bundled credentials or paid calls during preparation
environment.dependencies: Only Node built-ins in command packs; installed Pi/Fabric peers and Arbor tsx dependency
environment.optional: Held-out selection and grounding are explicit run choices; no automatic data or service download
